an4.25:1.1: Na-y-idaṃ bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ vussati janakuhanatthaṃ na janalapanatthaṃ na lābhasakkārasilokānisaṃsatthaṃ na itivādappamokkhānisaṃsatthaṃ na iti maṃ jano jānātūti. Atha kho idaṃ bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ vussati saṃvaratthaṃ pahānatthaṃ virāgatthaṃ nirodhatthan ti.
an4.25:2.1: Saṃvaratthaṃ pahānatthaṃ brahmacariyam anītihaṃ Adesayī so Bhagavā nibbānogadhagāminaṃ Esa maggo mahantehi anuyāto mahesihi
an4.25:3.1: Ye ca taṃ paṭipajjanti yathā Buddhena desitaṃ Dukkhass' antaṃ karissanti satthu sāsanakārino ti.
